title: Add live A2A retry scheduler coverage
summary: Prove the opt-in A2A retry scheduler works through a real daemon process, env configuration, capability grant, IPC task lease, timer scan, and audit feed.
expectedFailureModes: The scheduler works in unit tests but is never wired into the daemon binary.
The scheduler mutates stale tasks without the operator repair capability.
The scheduler requeues a task but operators cannot see the scan or repair event in audit output.
nextAction: Add an ignored live daemon test that enables the scheduler through env, sends an idempotent leased task, waits for automatic requeue, and asserts audit visibility.
